question: Can LeWM PushT 192-D latent transitions be represented in a reusable low-dimensional subspace without changing planner decisions materially?

representation_contract.matrix_low_rank_per_transition: not_applicable_to_a_single_192-D_transition; only the five-step trajectory stack is tested with an offline oracle SVD
representation_contract.tested_structure: reusable centered PCA subspace fitted only on calibration delta vectors

per_trajectory_oracle_lower_bound.basis_scope: fit separately from that trajectory's own full-model delta stack

step1.per_trajectory_oracle: For each observed or model-rollout trajectory, form its 5x192 delta stack and compute a separate rank-1..5 SVD reconstruction. This is an offline lower-bound diagnostic, not a reusable basis and not a deployable predictor.
report: per-trajectory oracle rank-1..5 explained energy and reconstruction error
calibration singular spectrum and cumulative centered variance
held-out relative MSE and cosine by rank

structure_gate.applies_to: reusable model-delta calibration PCA on held-out data; not to the per-trajectory oracle

step2.per_trajectory_oracle_definition: run the full LeWM predictor, form each candidate's 5x192 full-model delta stack, fit that candidate's own rank-1..5 SVD, cumulatively reconstruct future latents, and apply the unchanged official criterion. This is a hindsight lower bound only; it is never treated as a reusable basis or acceleration path.
step2.primary_reusable_basis_definition: run the full LeWM predictor, project each full-model delta through the frozen model-delta calibration PCA basis, cumulatively reconstruct future latents, and apply the unchanged official criterion/CEM
candidate_metrics: selected first-action normalized L2 against full teacher
teacher-objective regret of the approximate-selected candidate

candidate_gate.teacher_objective_regret: report for every block; no separate threshold because it remains in native official objective units

cem.eligible_approximate_arm: reusable model-delta calibration PCA only; per-trajectory oracle SVD is diagnostic and never eligible for CEM replacement
cem.run_policy: baseline and rank-192 exact-control plus the two smallest reusable-basis ranks passing the candidate gate; if none pass, do not run approximate-rank CEM

step2.negative_control: deterministic random orthonormal basis at rank 64 on held-out candidate banks

claim_boundary: This is a representation and fixed-observation planner oracle diagnostic. It does not demonstrate a cheap predictor, inference acceleration, or closed-loop PushT success.
